Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Increases the compact card by about 10% to 244×64.
- Removes the Last.fm suffix from the card.
- Adds Unicode-safe ... endings for long track and artist names.
- Slightly tightens the title-to-artist spacing.
